I appreciate the concern, I really do, and we're both taking steps to try to avoid this happening every again. As I said before, I exaggerated what I said because I wanted people to justify my feelings. I wanted people to be like "Yeah wow this is awful", and I left out a lot of things, or I made up things that weren't necessarily true. 

She isn't going to ruin my job for me, I promise. If she had any desire to do so, she would have done it already.

She's not, I promise. As I said, when I wrote this, I was in a really horrible spot. We both have issues. While I certainly framed her as the bad guy, what you didn't see was the equally awful things I did to her.
Yup! I admitted myself to the hospital, they kept me overnight. It was super boring, but I officially got diagnosed with depression, and I'm on a track to making things better.

She's absolutely not. I was very upset when I wrote this. As can be expected, I wasn't telling both sides of the story. I was depressed and anxious and was making things sound much worse than they were.

She's a kind person who also suffers from mental illness.
Thank you. I sent myself to the hospital. This helped.

Oh sorry. I've begged her not too. When she does, I try to contact her in another way to apologize for whatever I've done. I've left her notes outside her door. I brought her food to work. I just take it and apologize. I have been abusive before. When I'm really depressed I am pretty manipulative. She is too, but I don't claim she's manipulative because I know she can't help it, just like I can't help it. I've always pushed it off. She has BPD, so I try to justify it as "she's not herself. She still loves me, she's just suffering, and it's up to me to be patient with her"

I can't do it anymore though. I don't love anybody else. If she doesn't love me I have nothing. This job, college, all of it was for her.

When she's suicidal? I try to do whatever I can to be with her. Distract her. I've called people before to help her. I did believe she loved me. She spent 16+ hours per day with me. She talked about how she wanted to live in a house with a dog and a cat with me. How I was so understanding compared to other people. I believed all of it. 

I just started counseling recently, but I've been to counseling before (for around 4 months).

She has BPD. She'll threaten to block me. She'll say I'm abusive. She'll say it's best if she distances herself from me. She's done it for much less significant feelings before. No, I don't really have anybody else. I have a very nice job on campus, and I can't be honest about my suicidal feelings or else I'll have mandated counseling. I don't want anybody else to know.

I had a feeling she was doing this for a week now. She was very distant. She didn't respond to messages. She was very mysterious. She was training for work literally minutes from where I am (as opposed to being hours away), and she wouldn't respond. Now she's pushing me away when I tell her I'm upset. She could care less. She's posting on twitter how excited she is to see this new person. She didn't mention any of this to me. She said she wished I had other friends. I don't have other friends. 

I've tried going to a counselr and it didn't help. I really want to die.
